blocks.text: ALFONSO LISTA, Ifugao – President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Monday announced that 1,315 farmers would benefit from the P1.49-billion Alfonso Lista Pump Irrigation System (ALPIS), which he inaugurated in Barangay Sto. Domingo in this town. Marcos said his administration had prioritized irrigation for farmers when he assumed office in 2022. “Alam po naman natin na ang pinakamahalaga sa pagsasaka ay ang patubig. Malaki ang pagbabago kapag ang non-irrigated areas ay magawan na ng paaran na mapatubigan,” the President said.
